name: halo-v2
start: mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/halo" && if [ -n "$HALO_GCP_SA_KEY" ]; then (umask 177; printf '%s' "$HALO_GCP_SA_KEY" > "$HOME/.config/halo/gcp-adc.json"); echo "Wrote GCP ADC key to $HOME/.config/halo/gcp-adc.json"; else echo "HALO_GCP_SA_KEY not set; skipping GCP ADC setup"; fi

terminals.name: halo-dev
terminals.command: if [ -f "$HOME/.config/halo/gcp-adc.json" ]; then export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS="$HOME/.config/halo/gcp-adc.json"; fi; HALO_USE_SWIFTSHADER=1 pnpm dev
terminals.description: Control plane, workspace server, and Electron client; SwiftShader enabled for the headless renderer. Uses GCP ADC from $HOME/.config/halo/gcp-adc.json when present.

terminals.name: agentation-mcp
terminals.description: Agentation HTTP server so the dev toolbar can sync annotation notes
